reapack.name: StudioSync.lua
reapack.desc: StudioSync: record together remotely over a shared folder

version.author: James
version.changelog: StudioSync: the full rename. The ReaPack package, scripts, actions, repository and installers now carry the new name. If you installed it as BandSync, remove the BandSync repository in ReaPack and add this one.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A new install's ReaPack repository is called StudioSync, and the old name is switched off where it's found.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The nightly backup keeps its folders.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Deleting a copy can't freeze REAPER any more: it goes to the Recycle Bin in the background, with no hidden error box.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Clashes: the owner's change wins, and a Use mine button takes yours back straight from the message. New: colour the whole project, tracks by gradient, folder, instrument, person, newest work and more, and regions by section or along the song.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The classic panel is gone. New mirror tracks say (studio), old (band) ones still count. Several suggestions fold to one line with Review; each says what and how long ago; a grouped fader's suggestion says a folder or VCA goes straight through. Settings Health lists what needs you first, in columns when wide. Restore's filters fold when space is short. Studio cards sit side by side in a wide panel; project rows don't stretch. Driving isn't yellow. A panel failure now names itself in the console.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Track order is the same on every computer: whoever moves a track publishes the list, and each computer comes onto the newest one. A big restore runs in slices so REAPER keeps going, with one undo point. On a Mac, projects reopen at start with no load boxes, using REAPER's own -ignoreerrors (proven on Windows, needs a Mac test).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Produce: a button beside Follow and Listen. Hear someone record on your own grid as it happens, your song a moment behind theirs from your own copy, with Talk between takes; what's being sung over goes quiet here. By default over SonoBus with a position stamp and no server (new effects StudioSync stamp send and read); a NINJAM server is the other route. Colours: items by section, along the song, by person, lane or takes, and a live What's new view that fades over the hour.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tailscale is back in the installers, not optional: the NINJAM route reaches its server over it. The server's address is saved as this computer's Tailscale name, which doesn't change. Health says if Tailscale isn't installed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From the first Produce test over real SonoBus: SonoBus joins by itself sooner, a false 'no sound's arriving' warning is gone, the producer's side now hears that someone's recording, and whichever computer has the NINJAM server's folder runs it (in mirrored rooms there's no host).

version.author: James
version.changelog: More from the real Produce test: the stamp reader no longer loses its place when your transport starts, a steady tone can't pass for a stamp at the top of the song, and the NINJAM route cleans up after itself.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Produce button is on the people cards too, not only the docked list. Stopping the NINJAM route closes ReaNINJAM's window.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Produce through a NINJAM server now tested end to end: a play-through no longer leaves placeholders that play twice on the next pass, and the panel says this route has no talkback.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Docked at the bottom, the panel now looks right both tall and at the mixer's smallest height. Reopening a project no longer sends SWS's recolouring as your edit. Produce through a NINJAM server connects by itself, at the right level, and survives the server going away instead of crashing REAPER. Colouring items counts tracks you made. No more version box on every open.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A backup or autosave of a shared song now asks: open it as a side room you can merge from, or just look. Superior Drummer no longer re-sends the Drums after every playthrough. After a restart, tabs behind the front one sync again. Big projects hitch far less. NINJAM connects by itself on the Play tab and on a Mac, and reconnects if the server drops. Health says whether Tailscale is on.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM keeps trying for a few minutes when it can't reach the server, and says to press OK if ReaNINJAM shows a box: on a Mac nothing connects until that's pressed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: On a Mac, NINJAM connects once when the server answers, instead of retrying over a connection it can't see.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A shorter line when ReaNINJAM needs its box answered on a Mac.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A real backup file (.rpp-bak) now gets the backup bar; REAPER's offline-when-inactive setting is turned off once; old BandSync actions are removed; the nightly backup skips test songs.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Just look no longer carries over to a new tab of a backup.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The top bar says when the driver's away.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The NINJAM server now ships with StudioSync for Windows and Mac: the first computer to connect runs it, and the next takes over if it's gone. Host it here moves it by hand.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Changing Produce's route takes effect straight away; Bring into main no longer lists deletes of what main already lost.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Whoever's being produced follows the NINJAM server if it moves, and never starts one from an old address.

version.author: James
version.changelog: ReaNINJAM runs out of sight, with its status in the panel (Show it brings its window up). Health says whether Tailscale stays signed in. Produce takes the NINJAM server over if it goes, and everyone follows it if it moves.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A fresh NINJAM connect on a Mac no longer waits on a closed window; the connection box closes as soon as it opens; the route button stays put.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Health and the log say if Windows hasn't let the NINJAM server accept connections.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM connects straight away at the start of Produce; the route button stays under the pointer.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Every Produce connects straight away, not only the first.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM's status line uses the computer's short name.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Windows installer asks up front to let the NINJAM server accept connections, for Tailscale addresses only.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From a code review: a backup can't start syncing from Set up everything; a live NINJAM host isn't taken over by mistake; Stop server on the Play page; dead code removed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From a design review: less header on a small panel, a one-line put-back bar when it fits, full plug-in names, and a Copy button for the Tailscale line.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Stop server shows the server stopped straight away.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM keeps watching after it gives up, and connects once the server answers: a firewall box waiting for Allow no longer leaves everyone unconnected.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Stop server asks everyone on it to disconnect first, so no ReaNINJAM box appears (on a Mac one held StudioSync until OK). Copy buttons use SWS's clipboard where it's there.

version.author: James
version.changelog: After Stop server nobody presses Connect at a server that's going, and a server counts as answering only on two checks in a row.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Background checks hand back their newest answer: a stopped NINJAM server no longer reads as answering. A restarted server clears its stopping mark.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Window and Dock on the panel's title bar, always there; Draw and Show drawings on Chat's tab bar; smoother scrolling; less gap under the bar; a sharper big logo; a button to Tailscale's machines page in Health.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Invite a guest for a day: with a Tailscale access token (Settings > Advanced), an invitation also puts the guest's computer on your Tailscale network for a day, no account needed; old guests are taken off. Set up the tags: one click adds StudioSync's tagOwners lines to the Tailscale policy. The logo's flames and link are smooth at large sizes.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Guests for a day, tested on the real network: the Studios page gets a Guest button; someone who already has StudioSync and pastes a guest invitation is asked, then signed in to the inviter's Tailscale network for the day. A studio's buttons wrap on a narrow panel, and the title hides where it ran under Window and Dock.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Set up the tags can now limit guests: on Tailscale's starting policy it asks, then lets guests reach only StudioSync's file sharing and jams on your computers. Policies with their own rules are left alone.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Big songs no longer stall REAPER for 1.6 s every 10 s while Google Drive's copy catches up: Drive copies in short slices, never in the same pass as a look. The look nothing asked for comes less often on big songs. Live sync notes what slowed any tick over 0.15 s. Bin moves can't share a temp script.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: ReaNINJAM connects through a small local relay, so a NINJAM server that goes away no longer leaves its 'Disconnected from host!' alert holding every script: StudioSync disconnects cleanly and connects again when the server's back.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: the NINJAM relay no longer brings up ReaNINJAM's 'can't connect' alert when Connect is pressed while the server's down: it holds the connection quietly for up to 100 s and connects when the server's back. A reconnect left under an alert can't loop. Windows installer: a guest's Tailscale sign-in happens before the REAPER step, so a REAPER hiccup can't leave the invitation's key unused.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Windows installer: REAPER now gets its setup step. It was started as -nonewinst glued to the script's path, so a fresh REAPER showed its Usage box and StudioSync's scripts never arrived (found installing into a clean Windows Sandbox).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Windows installer: says to answer REAPER's first-start audio question and ReaPack's Manage repositories (the setup waits on them), and that Tailscale's welcome window may cover them. Checked end to end in a clean Windows Sandbox: with those answered, StudioSync installs and registers its actions.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: Connect works again after a Leave in the same REAPER session (ReaNINJAM keeps its one window, which StudioSync had noted as closed and skipped), and StudioSync opens at most one NINJAM connection box at a time (up to four were stacked, the top one taking every click).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: reconnecting after the NINJAM server goes away no longer brings up ReaNINJAM's 'can't connect' alert. The relay holds a new connection only 5 s (ReaNINJAM gives up after about 10), checks the server itself while idle, and StudioSync reconnects on that check, uncapped. README: Cancel the connection box before OK on the alert.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: reconnecting after a long NINJAM server outage presses the connection box that's on screen, not a closed copy macOS still lists, and gives each try a moment before trying again.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: no more connect/disconnect churn when NINJAM connection boxes pile up: once ReaNINJAM is connected or connecting, extra boxes are cancelled instead of pressed (16 connects in 15 s had ended in 'Error creating session directory!'). If a box won't take StudioSync's press for 20 s (another REAPER window in front, like ReaPack's report), the log says so.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Clashes: two changes to one item made apart are merged line by line; where both rewrote the notes or audio, the loser's version is kept as another take on its own lane. Quick nudges within 30 s count as one edit, and ties go to a clock that a wrong computer clock can't win. Producer mode: a performer can let the producer start, record and stop their transport. The Mac relay now quits when REAPER does.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Docked, the panel's top bar folds into a thin strip coloured by sync status (and Settings, when it wants a look); move the mouse to the top to open it. It stays open when it has something to press. Producer mode: each transport button has its own tip, and Record says when nothing is armed on the performer's side.
